title: claim
description: Sent instead of auth by an admin without the key: the master password sealed to the one-time key of the identity exchange (section 6.2). Endpoint: admin; direction: a2s; phase A. Unknown members are ignored by the reader (protocol.md section 8).

features.description: The admin features offered (challenge) or taken (auth, claim): `chunked`, chunked members (section 2.7); `identity`, the identity exchange (section 6.1), offered only.
